# <span id="aanchor163"></span> External Volume Default Values Editor

Use the External Volume Default Values Editor to set up editing preferences and default meter values for the [External Volume Interface](Manual%20Meter%20Input.md). The default values will be used if values are not provided.

<div class="procedure">

To access the External Volume Default Values Editor:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Meter**.

2.  Click **Default Values**.

3.  Select a meter number from the drop-down menu.

4.  Click the **Edit** button.

5.  If applicable, select the preferences for volume/energy/mass and raw data/pulses. 

    For volume/enery/mass, you can select accumulation for the period (total volume/energy/mass) or the beginning volume index. The ending index will be the start index for the next period. This setting determines whether you will enter total raw volume or pulses or index values for raw volume and pulses.

    The meter will default to "Accumulation" for the period and "Pulses".

    These selections are only applicable to linear meters. 

6.  If applicable, enter default values for static pressure, heating value, and temperature. The meter will use these values initially, but they can be overridden manually.

7.  Set the default seasonal temperatures.

    Specify season start dates on the [General tab](../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Configuration/System%20Configuration%20-%20General%20Tab.md) of the System Configuration Options screen.

8.  Click the **Save** button.
